libs.note: BH-8125. The type_otp() tool action of the web-task lane: makes a TOTP code at typing time from the vault (bin/lib/web-totp.sh), types it, and on a retry waits for the next TOTP window. The model never sees the code or the secret. Slice C1 of #8125 applies it with lib_env_apply web-otp in the web-task lane.

knobs.note: How many codes type_otp may type in one agent run: the first try plus the retries after a refused code. 2 = retry once. Past the cap the action answers `refused: otp refused` and the run stops. A value that is not an integer in 1..5 makes createTypeOtp throw; it is never clamped. Read by createTypeOtp as env WEB_TASK_OTP_ATTEMPTS, fallback 2.
